summary.text: Mike Reese is a Republican member of the Louisiana Senate, representing District 30 (Beauregard, Calcasieu, Rapides and Vernon parishes), and was elected in 2019, according to the official Senate member page.

paragraphs.text: The page lists committee assignments including the Select Committee on Military and Veterans Affairs, and caucus affiliations including the Acadiana Delegation, the Central Louisiana Delegation Caucus and the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
